summaryJa: 任務種別: JSR（OP SPARTAN SHIELD 支援のIMINT）。発信部隊: 50ATKS、コールサイン: 1.4a、機数: 1。離陸/着陸/配置/離局/総時間は原文のDTGを記載: Takeoff 240015:00ZOCT23（OMAM）、On Station 240155:00ZOCT23、Off Station 241912:00ZOCT23、Landing 242058:00ZOCT23、Total Mission Time 20:43、Total Time On Station 17:17。0155–1837ZにてNAVCENT対応でIMINTを実施。AIRHANDLER経由でSIGINTを収集。ガードコール: 240145ZにIRANIAN_AIR_DEFENSEから「国境から安全な距離を保て」とのプロフェッショナルな呼び出しを受信、当機は「連合航空機で国際空域で任務中」と回答、呼び出しは0145Zに停止。UAP: Initial Contact 240241:00ZOCT23。観測記録ではUAPは「固体」、熱像は冷（THERMAL SHOWED COLD）、機動性の所見なし、知的制御は否と評価、機器や人的被害なし、観測者は交戦せず。FMVはDGS-2で解析。事前調整時間154分、事前調整の有効性は「満足」。機微情報・個人情報は原文で伏せ字あり。
summaryEn: Mission type: JSR supporting OP SPARTAN SHIELD (IMINT). Originator: 50ATKS; callsign 1.4a; 1 aircraft. Timeline (as reported): Takeoff 240015:00Z OCT23 (OMAM); On Station 240155:00Z OCT23; Off Station 241912:00Z OCT23; Landing 242058:00Z OCT23. Total mission time 20:43; time on station 17:17. Conducted IMINT for NAVCENT from 0155–1837Z. Collected SIGINT via AIRHANDLER. Guard call: at 240145Z Iranian Air Defense issued a professional guard call to “maintain safe distance from border”; crew responded that it was a coalition aircraft conducting routine operations in international airspace; calls ceased at 0145Z. UAP: Initial contact 240241:00Z. Reported UAP assessed as benign and solid; thermal signature "cold"; no maneuverability observed; assessed not under intelligent control; no effects on personnel; observer did not engage. FMV was exploited by DGS-2. Precoord time 154 minutes; precoord effectiveness satisfactory. Source document contains redactions for sensitive/personal data.
